doc_friction.issue: Step 0's open list held 14 entries, 12 of them control-plane edits needing their own owner-approved PR and 2 needing sources this container cannot reach (gov.uk 403); every red-team run re-reads and re-skips them. The list could mark control-plane-blocked entries so runs skip them in one glance.

notes: Targets: xer-schedule-check cpm.mjs (10 mutants, 8 caught) and constraints.mjs (8, 4 caught), both paid products (transition.json proprietary). Escaped: 2 equivalent (cpm.mjs:689 under the default variant; constraints.mjs:86 hh 24 rolls the date so the getUTCDate check rejects it), 4 gaps guarded (ALAP milestone with remaining hours in the file, every month name, 3-digit month, past=false for cleared rows and started work). rerun: all 4 caught_after_fix. Catch rate 12/18 (0.67) raw, 12/16 = 0.75 of non-equivalent before, 1.0 after. Class fix: the per-cell day/month guess found in constraints.mjs was grepped across ventures; league-schedule-generator had it in a range parser (fixed, all four list parsers); cash-application-matcher has an explicit dayFirst switch (fine); shift-cover-optimizer/calc.mjs:356 had it too (fixed); client-rebooking-predictor already counts dmy/mdy per file (not changed). Verification: run_venture_tests.py xer-schedule-check ok (561 tests); league-schedule-generator see below. CI on this PR: changed-ventures was red only on platform/distribution/webext.test.mjs (red on main since #18712; fixed here). Portfolio Pages 'test' has 3 failures that are red on main and outside this diff: build.test.mjs:5005 (category count wording) and :5477 (catch-all has 6 tools), description-length.test.mjs (3 ebay-fee-calculator guides and hearth-and-horizon/the-stall-that-paid-double.html over 160 chars). Open PR #18690 touches build.mjs/build.test and the hearth page; the ebay guides were in no open PR and were left for a later run to avoid racing active sessions. Local runs: xer-schedule-check 561, shift-cover-optimizer 42, league-schedule-generator 1029, platform/distribution 261 tests, all pass.

real_defects.issue: parseLogDate read each slash date alone, so in one UK constraints log 25/12/2025 read as 25 Dec but 03/12/2025 as 12 March (a December delivery shown overdue), with no warning. Fixed: slashOrder() picks one order for the whole log (dmy/mdy, warning when mixed); test 'one date order for the whole log'.

parseDate read each date alone, so the blackout '20/12/2026 to 05/01/2027' ended on 1 May 2027 and blocked 133 days instead of 17, silently (under the 365-day range cap). Fixed: dateOrder() over the whole text box (parseDateList, parseBlackouts, parseDivisionBlackouts, parseCourtClosures), an error asking for YYYY-MM-DD when both orders appear with an ambiguous date; two tests in calc.test.mjs.

parseStamp read each POS export row alone, so in a UK export 27/10/2026 read day-first but 03/11/2026 as 11 March: every order on the 1st-12th of a month was bucketed under the wrong weekday in demandFromHistory. Fixed: stampOrder() over the time column (warning when mixed); test 'one day/month order for the whole export'; the old mixed-file test split into a US and a day-first file.

Red on main: NETWORK_RE flagged every dynamic import(, so after PR #18712 made shift-roster-builder load its importers with import("./import-staff.mjs") the browser-extension packager skipped it ('inline script reaches the network') and webext.test 'the real shift-roster-builder qualifies' failed in the unwired checks. Fixed: a relative string-literal import() is a local file (importsOf already follows and packages it); URLs, variables and templates still count as network. Test: 'a dynamic import of a local file is packaged'.
